notes.title: PvE Zombie Gamemode Added!
notes.content:
[h1]Change logs: [/h1]

[b]Brand new gamemode added: PvE[/b]
Welcome to 'Zombie Overrun: Urban Nightmare,' where the city's streets are your battlefield! Team up with friends to fend off relentless waves of zombies throughout the city. Scavenge for special crates filled with powerful perks and grab power-ups dropped from the zombies to gain an edge. It's a fight for survival in the heart of the city—how long can you and your team withstand the undead onslaught?

Maximum players for PvE is 4
Perks can be purchased from the crate on the map
Zombies have a chance to drop power ups such as a Nuke, Instakill (Affects current spawned in wave when taken), health and Stamina

There is a lot more features that will be added and improved in the future.

We welcome all forms of feedback on our discord server.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 13/07/2024
notes.content:
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]New Game mode: [u]Capture The Flag [/u]
Stand on the flag base, Press E. Take to your base and Press E to capture it. Simple!
[*]Confirmation on quitting/Back to main menu
[/list]

[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Leader board text changed - RED/BLUE TEAM | TEAM SCORE to BLUE/RED TEAM
[*]Main Menu - Discord Icon moved
[/list]



[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Game session not destroying when client time-out from match/host crashing/force quitting.
[/list]
